summary.en: A school roof collapsed in Peshawar, killing dozens of children and a teacher, prompting families to demand justice and authorities to order inspections. Pakistani security forces responded to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban forces along the Kurram border. Pakistan suspended Iran trade corridors citing security and smuggling concerns. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et skoletak kollapset i Peshawar, og drepte dusinvis av barn og en lærer, noe som fikk familiene til å kreve rettferdighet og myndighetene til å beordre inspeksjoner. Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker svarte på uprovokert skyting fra afghanske Taliban-styrker langs Kurram-grensen. Pakistan suspendert iranske handelskorridorer med henvisning til sikkerhets- og smuglingsbekymringer. Konflikten registrerte 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
